# Spare Kestrel-3 logger policy

The network keeps one configured Kestrel-3 logger as a controlled spare. It
is not fitted routinely: taking a good logger out of an AWS creates another
unnecessary change and obscures the reason for the visit.

## When to carry it

Carry the spare on a visit when an AWS has repeated unexplained resets,
unreadable stored observations, physical damage near the logger terminals, or
an agreed replacement job. The volunteer should also take it when travelling
to a remote station after a report that the battery and radio are otherwise
healthy but the logger has stopped recording.

## After use

Label the removed logger with its station and date, then return it to the
workshop for inspection. The spare slot must be replenished before the next
storm season. Do not treat the Kestrel-3 as a general-purpose diagnostic
device or lend it to a site without an AWS replacement plan.
